name: New Orleans
//why: A second city is here to answer one question honestly: what in this system is universal and what was Atlanta all along? REGISTRY I ported with nothing but this file — bbox, tiling, and a name. REGISTRY II did not, and the institutional block below says exactly why.

institutional.body: Neighborhood Participation Program (NPP) — advisory, not the NPU's chartered review role
institutional.//status: SKETCHED, NOT RUNNABLE. The NPP is not the NPU: participation is convened per application rather than by standing chartered unit, so 'the agenda item' does not segment the same way. A real REGISTRY II here needs its own segmentation rule, its own planOf gazetteer, and its own anchor set — halfworld/world.config.json is forked, not parameterised. Nothing about this city's institutional lane should be trusted until that fork exists and its gates pass.
